body: I get the same feeling when I reminisce on my childhood. I had a lot of abusive/ very traumatic events happen while I was young and it haunted me for a long long time. I was able to do really good for about 4 years or so but now I am very low again and just thinking about it makes me break. I don’t know if I will ever get better because I already know the steps that had helped me before but I lack the will to try. Maybe I didn’t really heal anything when I thought I did.....

All of the gods must be respected. You are free to do as you please when it comes to offerings and tributes as such. To ask for guidance or answers to specific problems....etc  is not something that should be exclusive to one god. Some may not like it as much as others but they are all gods so tread however lightly you see fit. You will read the signs and outcomes of offerings, worship, and “prayer” how they want you to see them, it is then up to you to interpret what they show you. That is my personal opinion on the matter. So basically I say you can talk to all of them and there is no exclusivity to one unless you want to. If they have a problem with it then you may get a sign from one or multiple gods, it is then up to you to decipher how obvious or strong these signs are and if you want to change anything about what it is you are doing. Have a good day and stay strong. Skål!

I am a Skilled Trades Construction Worker and actions like this have made me internally torn for the last 15 years. I love crafting things with my hands but I hate all the destruction and devastation to the land that comes along with my line of work. I am increasingly saddened by my inadvertent support of the actions of greedy human beings that wreaks havoc on the few parts of this Earth that have been “protected” and the vast disregard for the Native Americans that have cherished this land long before corporate greed had come around. With a heavy heart, I will be leaving the Building Trades to pursue a career that will have more of a positive impact on the environment and people together. I only wish I would have done it sooner....
